8. The executed service, inventory and computation

The controller uses private plant faults and finite observations. It does not receive fault identities. The reference includes:

Six pose corrections.
Four false-seat recoveries.
One failed replacement cartridge.
Two degraded-bar replacements.
An active pump failure and failed first standby.

That gives 15 modeled recoveries.

Quantity	Reference service	Separate post-handoff reset	Combined paid cycle
Represented attachment/detachment/transfer operations	4,997	2,177	7,174
Machine time	77.557 h	30.812 h	108.369 h
Process electricity	38.233 kWh	15.031 kWh	53.264 kWh
Loose replacement wafers	272	168	440
Destroyed wafers including rejected stocked cartridges	282	168	450
Cartridge-cut cycles	141	84	225
Individual punches	1,128	672	1,800

The accepted reference state retains geometry C with 42 bars and eight crossframes, with no construction holder, saddle or capture head supporting its equipment load.

The later reset occurs only after customer handoff. It is charged economically and dismantles C; the model does not retain C as output and simultaneously return its parts to the depot.

All 116 cartridge IDs reconcile. Both ordinary staging pockets finish empty. The wafer mass balance closes, and 60 loose wafers remain after the combined cycle. Five cartridges, two bar bodies and two pump branches require paid replenishment or refurbishment.

Fifteen consistency checks pass, including time, electricity, operation counts, part locations, wafer mass and the absence of tool support at the modeled acceptance boundary.

The computational package also includes actual pixel processing of synthetic images. It accepted 75 of 80 images, rejected the five occluded cases, and had maximum accepted translation error about 0.418 mm. This is not an installed-vision qualification.

The proposed controller budgets an industrial PC, safety PLC, finite logs, 100 Hz force/position acquisition, local 1 kHz drive loops and bounded observation age. Offline Python execution is not evidence that the installed system meets those deadlines.

title: Do not retain the frame and return its parts simultaneously
